Discussion
The developed system successfully integrates modern Artificial Intelligence techniques
including Retrieval-Augmented Generation, semantic search, vector databases, and Large
Language Models into a unified research platform.
Experimental evaluation demonstrates that the system effectively answers user queries
using uploaded research documents while maintaining transparency through citation gen-
eration. The modular architecture also provides flexibility for future enhancements in-
cluding cloud deployment, multilingual support, OCR integration, and advanced research
analytics.
